description: One page of the AcuiQ reference wiki in full: its text, version, update date and metadata. Address it by `path` ("tag/path/slug", exactly the `path` or `url` a listing returns), or by `tagPath` + `slug`; a category's own path reads its hub article. Not a title. For 2 to 20 pages call get_pages, one round trip rather than N. A miss names the nearest pages, so a wrong guess is fixed in one retry. A page's URL with `.md` appended is its markdown. With `blocks: true`, `content` is the stored block array, ids and all, beside the page `id` and its whole `metadata`: read a page this way before editing it, and send its `version` back as the edit's baseVersion.

blocks.description: Return the stored blocks rather than prose, for an edit

path.description: The page's whole path, e.g. "developers/scrypto/blueprints". Preferred over tagPath + slug.

slug.description: Page slug. Ignored when `path` is set.

tagPath.description: Tag path only ("" for a top-level page). Ignored when `path` is set.

name: get_page
title: Read a page
